title: Filipino Pancit Canton Noodle Stir Fry
description: A classic Filipino dish made with stir-fried noodles, vegetables, and your choice of protein. Cooked to perfection, this Pancit Canton recipe is a staple in every Filipino household.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic and stir-fry until the onion is translucent.
Add the sliced mushrooms and chopped bean sprouts and stir-fry until the vegetables are tender.
Add the cooked noodles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and stir-fry for another minute.
Transfer the pancit canton to a serving platter and garnish with chopped green onions.
Optional: Add protein of your choice (e.g., chicken, pork, or tofu) and stir-fry until cooked through.
